subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the current redacted predicate transcript plus fault-injected test evidence enough for this retry/session change, or should the author add full-runner or gateway proof before merge?
rationale: The code shape appears sound, but the change affects retry ordering, harness result contracts, session state, and message delivery, and the remaining gate is maintainer proof sufficiency rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs or terminal output from a real runner/gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects.

options.title: Accept current proof and own the risk
options.body: A maintainer may decide the source inspection and fault-injected coverage are sufficient despite the lack of a full user-path artifact.

options.title: Select another canonical PR
options.body: If maintainers prefer an overlapping open candidate, pause or close this branch after linking the chosen landing path.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs or terminal output from a real runner/gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicate tool or delivery side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on adjacent embedded-runner terminal-state and harness changes touched by this PR.
